Kamal Haasan Responds to Elon Musk's Tweets on India

Actor and politician Kamal Haasan responded to tweets by Elon Musk regarding India, stating that Indians will address their strengths and shortcomings internally, asserting that "India is a democracy, not a colony." This statement came after Musk shared reports about donations from Reliance-backed firms to the BJP. Musk's engagement with Indian matters also included a tweet about Starlink licensing, which Republic World cited as a reason for Haasan's response, mentioning national security.
